description: Parses the System Resource Usage Monitor database (SRUDB.dat), optionally with the SOFTWARE hive.
usage: Parses the System Resource Usage Monitor database (SRUDB.dat) to show per-application CPU, network and energy use over time. Use it to find what ran and how much data it sent, even weeks back.
limitation: SRUM keeps about 30 days of hourly resource-use totals per application. It does not give exact activity times.

parameters.label: SOFTWARE hive
parameters.description: SOFTWARE hive to process. Optional, but recommended.

parameters.label: Directory
parameters.description: Directory to recursively process, looking for SRUDB.dat and SOFTWARE hive (KAPE-style output).
